subject: LaunchLabs accelerator: partner-sourced credits + usage guardrails
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@launchlabs.io>

Cc: Sofia Mendes <sofia@launchlabs.io>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 14:15:00 +0000
Subject: Request: cohort credits for LaunchLabs 'Cohort B' (December)

Hi Jasmine,

Hope you're well — LaunchLabs is kicking off Cohort B on Dec 8 and we had a successful pilot with Redwood during Cohort A. Several startups want to continue testing with dedicated credits surfaced through our marketplace listing.

Quick ask: can Redwood allocate partner-sourced promotional credits for up to 10 startups (total initial pool 1M tokens) tied to the LaunchLabs program? We need the credits to be claimable via our marketplace promo code and to expire March 31, 2027.

Attached is the cohort SOW and a draft partner referral form. If you need an LOI or an MOU, we can sign a simple one-page addendum. Also copying Sofia (our partnerships lead) for logistics.

Appreciate a timeline — cohort onboarding starts next week.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Partnerships | LaunchLabs Inc.
liam@launchlabs.io
+1 415-555-0189

Attachments: LL_CohortB_SOW.pdf (PDF, 240KB); partner_referral_form.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)

From: jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@launchlabs.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, ava_chen@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 16:00:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: cohort credits for LaunchLabs 'Cohort B' (December)

Hi Liam — great to hear Cohort B is moving forward and glad Cohort A went well.

Short answers up front: we can support partner-sourced promotional credits but need to confirm a few items before we finalize allocation:
- Exact credit bucket (1M tokens sounds fine; please confirm whether you want a single pooled promo code or per-startup allocations).
- Billing/attribution: will LaunchLabs be covering overages beyond the promo pool, or do you want those to fall back to each startup's payment method?
- Legal/terms: we need either an MOU or a signed DocuSign addendum referencing our standard promo terms (I've attached our credit_terms.docx for scope).

I've looped in Ben (sales) to confirm commercial sign-off and Ava (ecosystem) for marketplace fulfillment steps. If you can confirm the pooled vs per-entity model and sign the addendum by EOD Friday (Dec 4), we can push codes to your marketplace catalog by Dec 7.

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com

--

Subject: Fwd: Request: cohort credits for LaunchLabs 'Cohort B' (need quick approval)

Ben / Ava — forwarding LaunchLabs request. Key asks: 1M tokens expiring 2027-03-31, preference is a single pooled promo code they can distribute, and they'll sign our addendum. Cohort onboarding Dec 8; they want codes live by Dec 7.

Commercial considerations: do we subsidize the pool (marketing credit) or treat as a co-funded promotion? If co-funded, LaunchLabs will cover overages. Ben — can you greenlight a marketing credit up to $X (we should map token units to $) or do you want to propose a cost split to Liam?

Operational notes for Ava: marketplace fulfillment requires the promo code, docs in our partner portal, and a HubSpot tie to deal LL-ACC-2026-078. I'll prepare the DocuSign addendum if we get sign-off.

Thanks — quick replies appreciated, timeline is tight.

Subject: Approved: LaunchLabs cohort credit pool + next steps

Hi Liam / Sofia — good news, we're approved to support Cohort B. Summary of agreed terms below and next steps.

Summary (agreed):
- Promo pool: 1.2M tokens (marketing-funded $2,000 USD equivalent).
- Distribution: single pooled promo code that LaunchLabs can distribute to cohort startups.
- Per-claim cap: 150k tokens.
- Expiry: 2027-03-31.
- Overages: LaunchLabs to cover any usage beyond the pool; Redwood will notify the code owner when 80% of the pool is consumed.
- Legal: LaunchLabs to sign the DocuSign addendum linked below; Redwood's standard promo terms apply (see attached credit_terms.docx).

Operational next steps:
1) Ava will provision the promo code in the marketplace and upload partner_referral_form.xlsx to the partner portal (ETA: Dec 7).
2) Liam to confirm pooled vs per-entity distribution (we're provisioning a pooled code by default).
3) Liam to sign DocuSign addendum: https://www.docusign.com/launchlabs-credit-agreement/xyz123
4) Redwood will attach HubSpot Deal LL-ACC-2026-078 to the promo code for tracking.

Please confirm and I'll mark the deal as approved on our side and route the marketing credit.

Thanks and excited to support Cohort B.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
